regressionLinearIntroductionRevision.change: Expanded the approximate line rule, added a same-input/different-response illustration, and explained the random-error observation model.

correctionsRetained: Model selection uses validation instead of repeatedly selecting by final test error.
The slope sampling standard deviation is sigma/sqrt(Sxx), rather than the response-error standard deviation sigma.
RSE is a standard deviation; its square estimates variance.
The 90 plotted observations give t approximately 5.99193 and a two-sided p-value approximately 4.445e-8.
A small association p-value and an adjusted coefficient change do not establish causality.
OLS computation does not require normal errors; exact classical t inference needs the stated stronger assumptions.
Multiple regression has several predictors and one response.
